title: 盐从记忆里长出来
timeWindow: three months, centered on one interrupted memory procedure

review.structure: five-stage consent dilemma and long-term care arc
checks: the four salt jars, yellow raincoat, red float and shoulder taps form a continuous motif chain
the fictional treatment distinguishes memory weathering from irreversible deletion
the mother retains agency through advance directives and lucid-window decisions
the climax is triggered by both measurable protocol drift and emotional recognition
the ending preserves the cost and progression of care instead of offering a miraculous cure
